title: Effective descent and morphism gluing for sheaves of sets along a covering
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with all fibre products, and let $\{U_a\to U\}_{a\in A}$ be a covering. Work in a universe containing the objects, arrows and index set $A$, closed under the products below [def-weil-size-convention]. For an object $V\to U$, restriction to the slice site $\mathcal C/V$ means $F|_V(W\to V)=F(W\to V\to U)$ for a sheaf on $\mathcal C/U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. For each $a$ let $F_a$ be a sheaf of sets on $\mathcal C/U_a$ and let $\phi_{ab}:F_a|_{U_a\times_UU_b}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_b|_{U_a\times_UU_b}$ be isomorphisms, including when $a=b$. Suppose $\phi_{ac}=\phi_{bc}\circ\phi_{ab}$ after restriction to each triple fibre product. There is a sheaf of sets $F$ on $\mathcal C/U$ and isomorphisms $e_a:F|_{U_a}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_a$ with $e_b=\phi_{ab}\circ e_a$ on each double fibre product. Moreover, for sheaves of sets $P,Q$ on $\mathcal C/U$, every family of maps $f_a:P|_{U_a}\to Q|_{U_a}$ agreeing on the double fibre products is the restriction of a unique map $f:P\to Q$.
